speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. Please tell me, how old are you and have you started your periods yet? Also, what unusual physical features have you or your parents noticed on your body?

speaker: Patient
text: 16-year-old female. The patient has not experienced menarche. She was noted to have partial labial fusion and clitoromegaly at birth. The patient's mother reports that during pregnancy she had abnormal hair growth on her chin. The patient has a history of severe acne and has sustained fractures following minor trauma. She is currently on oral isotretinoin and an oral contraceptive.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Congenital Adrenal Hyperplasia (21-hydroxylase deficiency) presenting with salt-wasting or simple virilizing forms, leading to primary amenorrhea and ambiguous genitalia.

REQUEST TEST: Serum 17-hydroxyprogesterone, ACTH stimulation test.
REQUEST IMAGES: Pelvic ultrasound to assess for uterus and ovaries.
